Markets.title: Rentomojo IPO: BlackRock among investors in Rs 376 crore anchor round
Markets.summary: Furniture rental startup Rentomojo raised Rs 376 crore from 41 anchor investors, including BlackRock and Goldman Sachs, ahead of its initial public offering on September 9. The company issued 93 million shares to these institutional investors at a price of Rs 404 per share.

Markets.title: ARCIL IPO: Goldman Sachs, BofA among investors in Rs 220 crore anchor round
Markets.summary: Asset Reconstruction Company India raised Rs 220 crore from 21 anchor investors by allotting 1.58 crore shares at Rs 139 each. Prominent participants in this round included Goldman Sachs and BofA Securities ahead of the company's IPO opening on September 9.

Markets.title: NSE likely to price IPO at Rs 1,700-1,785 per share after a cut, say sources
Markets.summary: National Stock Exchange of India has reportedly lowered its IPO price range to Rs 1,700-1,785 per share and reduced the stake on offer to 5.5%. This adjustment values the exchange at up to 4.42 trillion rupees.

Markets.title: Karamtara Engineering raises Rs 262 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO. HDFC MF among top buyers
Markets.summary: Karamtara Engineering raised Rs 262.50 crore from anchor investors, including HDFC Mutual Fund, ahead of its IPO. The public subscription for the solar module mounting structure manufacturer opens on September 9 and closes on September 11.

Markets.title: Jio IPO: Co set to begin investor outreach later this week, say sources
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms is starting global investor outreach this week for its upcoming initial public offering after receiving Sebi approval. The company will issue fresh equity shares to raise capital primarily to repay its subsidiary's outstanding borrowings.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their decline on Tuesday, with the Sensex falling 555 points and the Nifty closing below 23,650. Analysts attributed the drop to elevated crude prices, Federal Reserve rate hike concerns, and IPO fund absorption, while technical indicators point to 23,600 as a key support level for the Nifty.

Geo-Political.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
Geo-Political.summary: The UK government has imposed sanctions on West Bank settlers, with the foreign secretary accusing them of the ethnic cleansing of Palestinians. In response, Israel has shut down the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

Geo-Political.title: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
Geo-Political.summary: Canada has imposed tariffs as high as 50% on nearly $20 billion worth of US products, including steel and T-shirts. Mark Carney warned that the ongoing US trade war will come at a cost in response to these actions.

Geo-Political.title: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
Geo-Political.summary: Valuable paintings by Renoir were stolen during a heist at a French museum. This incident is part of a recent wave of high-profile art thefts across Europe that has raised concerns about museum security.

Geo-Political.title: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
Geo-Political.summary: Argentina plans to file a criminal case against an oil company operating near the Falkland Islands. This action follows President Javier Milei's recent intensification of Argentina's sovereignty claims over the territory.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian drone strike hit a Ukrainian television channel building in Kyiv during a daytime attack. The assault killed five people, prompting President Zelensky to condemn the incident as a new level of Russian degradation.

Geo-Political.title: British widow faces deportation from Sweden after 22 years
Geo-Political.summary: A 78-year-old British woman who has lived in Sweden for 22 years faces deportation for failing to submit a Brexit residence application by the deadline. Swedish authorities have denied her appeals to remain in the country.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when querying ChatGPT for product recommendations. This traffic was generated without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also provides examples of top programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: RBI overnight cash withdrawal auction: Banks park  ₹3.53 lakh crore after tepid 30-day auction
Data & Insights.summary: On September 7, banks showed little interest in the Reserve Bank of India's 30-day variable rate reverse repo auction by submitting bids below the notified amount. However, banks parked ₹3.53 lakh crore in a separate overnight funds auction, showing a clear preference for shorter parking periods.

Data & Insights.title: Why India’s 7.8% GDP growth isn’t enough to celebrate
Data & Insights.summary: Although India's post-pandemic GDP growth has exceeded seven percent, this economic rate remains insufficient to meaningfully improve the population's living standards. Consequently, the country requires even higher growth to drive widespread improvements in citizens' daily lives.

Data & Insights.title: US-Iran war impact: India adds new suppliers amid crude supply disruption, but only 5 nations control imports — Check
Data & Insights.summary: Due to US-Iran war disruptions, India expanded its crude oil sourcing to 31 countries. However, supplier concentration rose sharply as just five nations now control its imports.

Data & Insights.title: 'Fictional, loose figment of irrational tit-bits': SBI report refutes claims of missing nominal GDP data
Data & Insights.summary: An SBI report dismissed claims of missing nominal GDP data as unfounded fiction and defended the reliability of Q1 FY27 growth estimates. It emphasized that data revisions are simply a normal statistical practice.

Data & Insights.title: India plans to pool factory energy demand to power a green switch
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to pool the energy demand of factories to purchase green power in bulk for better prices. This initiative aims to help manufacturers reduce both their energy costs and emissions while making clean electricity a more secure alternative to gas.

Data & Insights.title: CII business confidence rebounds in Q2 on improving demand, hiring and investment outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The CII Business Confidence Index rose to 66 in Q2FY27. This rebound was driven by stronger domestic demand, higher capacity utilization, and easing cost pressures.

India.title: Death Penalty For 1, Jail For 2 In 2022 Tamil Nadu Minor Gang-Rape Case
India.summary: An Indian court sentenced one man to death and two others to prison for the 2022 gang-rape of a minor in Tamil Nadu. Muneeswaran received 13 years and Murugesan received 20 years in prison for their roles in the crime.

India.title: Who Was Rakesh Mehta? Sheila Dikshit's Top Official During Commonwealth Games
India.summary: Rakesh Mehta, a former IAS officer and top official under Sheila Dikshit during the Commonwealth Games, was found dead at his Noida residence. Police recovered a suicide note in which the 1975-batch officer cited mental and health issues as the reasons for taking his own life.

India.title: Ex-Delhi Chief Secretary Rakesh Mehta Dies By Suicide In Noida Flat
India.summary: Former Delhi Chief Secretary Rakesh Mehta died by suicide at his Noida apartment. The 1975-batch Indian Administrative Service officer had previously served under former Chief Minister Sheila Dikshit.

India.title: "Unparliamentary": Himachal Officers Slam Kangana Ranaut's "Lazy" Comment
India.summary: The Himachal Pradesh Block Development Officers Association condemned MP Kangana Ranaut's "lazy" remark as unparliamentary language. The association warned that they may take strong action if she repeats such conduct or language.

India.title: Rights Body Intervenes On Suicide Of Punjab Man Who Flagged Drugs Menace
India.summary: India's National Human Rights Commission has intervened in the suicide of Gulzar Singh, a Punjab man who had flagged the local drugs menace. The rights body requested his dying declaration, inquest and postmortem reports, and all other relevant records.

India.title: No Terror Charges Yet On US Mercenary Matthew VanDyke, 6 Ukrainians In 'Drone Training' Case
India.summary: US citizen Matthew VanDyke and six Ukrainians have not yet been charged with terrorism in an ongoing drone training case in India. VanDyke's family has requested diplomatic intervention from the United States government ahead of his scheduled interrogations on September 2 and 3.

General.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
General.summary: Britain's foreign secretary accused West Bank settlers of ethnic cleansing and announced sanctions against them. In response, Israel shut down the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

General.title: Ports denied request to land 120 migrants in RNLI boats
General.summary: On Sunday, the King's Harbour Master and Southampton Port refused requests to let 120 migrants land using RNLI boats. Both port authorities denied permission for the individuals to come ashore.

General.title: Trump shares misleading video of King and fainting worker
General.summary: Former President Donald Trump shared a misleading video on social media that appeared to show King Charles walking away from a man who had fainted. In reality, the King stopped to check on the worker and waited with him until medical staff arrived.

General.title: Glastonbury confirms ticket sale dates - and highest ever price
General.summary: Glastonbury Festival will return in June following a fallow year. Tickets for the event have exceeded £400 for the first time.

General.title: British widow faces deportation from Sweden after 22 years
General.summary: A 78-year-old British woman who has lived in Sweden for 22 years faces deportation. She is being forced to leave because she failed to submit her Brexit residence application on time.

General.title: Prince George attends first day at Eton College
General.summary: Thirteen-year-old Prince George attended his first day at Eton College. Prince William and Princess Catherine of Wales dropped him off at the all-boys boarding school.
